coordinate_frame: front=0; diagram-left=negative; diagram-right=positive; stored camera-right bearings are multiplied by -1 and then shifted -4.0 degrees before fusion

steps.title: Matching face + live speech at -20°
steps.instruction: Stand on the -20° floor mark: 20° toward diagram-left from front-centre, at 1 m radius. Face Reachy. During RECORDING, say ‘Reachy, this is a sound-direction test.’ naturally about every 2 seconds. Keep your feet on the mark.

steps.title: Silent visible face at -20°
steps.instruction: Stand at the -20° diagram-left mark, 1 m from Reachy. Face Reachy, remain silent and still, and keep all playback stopped during RECORDING.

steps.title: Silent visible face at +20°

steps.title: Silent face -20° + phone speech +20°
steps.instruction: Stand silently on the -20° diagram-left mark, facing Reachy. Place the phone on the +20° diagram-right mark at 1 m. During RECORDING play the same podcast-speech clip at about 35% volume. Keep your face visible and do not speak.
